paite: Kanaan gam a galdou kha nai het lou Israelte etchetna ding in TOUPA'N hiai namte anusia hi.
heading: Gamsung A Om Lai Namte

paite: Atup bel Israel suante, tuma a galdoudan thei nai hetloute galdoudan sinsak ahihna ding lel ahi.
Huaite bel: Philistiate kumpipa ngate, Kanaan mi tengte, Sidonte leh Lebanon tang a teng Hivte ahi ua, Baal-hermon tang a pan Hamath lutna pha in ahi uh.
TOUPA'N Mosi zang a apipute uh thu ana piakte azuih ding uh leh zuih louh ding uh theihna ding in, huaite Israelte chetna ding ahi uh.
Israel suante Kanaante, Hitte, Amorte, Perizte, Hivte leh Jebuste lak ah ateng uhi.
Atanute uh zi in anei ua, atanute uh atapate uh zi in apia ua, apathiante uh nna asem uhi.
Israel suante'n TOUPA mitmuh in thil gilou ahih ua, TOUPA a Pathian uh amangngilh ua, Baal leh Astoreth nna asem uhi.
heading: Othniel

paite: Huchi in TOUPA Israelte tung ah ahehta a, Mesopo Mesopotamia gam kumpipa Kushan-risathaim kiang ah azuakta hi. Huchi in Israel suante'n Kushan-risathaim nna kum giat asem uhi.
Israel suante'n TOUPA asaptak un, TOUPA'N Israel suante hunkhepa abawlsak a, huai mi in amau ahunkheta hi. Huai mi bel Kaleb naupa Kenaz tapa Othniel ahi.
TOUPA kha atung ah ahong tung a, Israel tung ah vai ahawm hi. Ama'n Mesopotamia gam kumpipa Kushan-risathaim ava dou a, TOUPA'N Kushan-risathaim a khut ah apia a, azouta hi.
Huchi in kum sawmli gam galmuang in a-omta a, huchi in Kenaz tapa Othniel asita hi.
Israel suante'n TOUPA mitmuh in thil gilou ahih nawn uh. TOUPA mitmuh a thil ahihkhelh ziak un TOUPA'N Israelte tung ah Moab kumpipa Eglon ahatsak hi.
heading: Ehud

paite: Ama'n Ammon leh Amalek suante akaikhawm a; Israelte ava dou a, tum sing khopi aluahta hi.
Huchi in Moab kumpipa Eglon thunuai ah Israelte kum sawm-le-giat a-om uhi.
Himahleh Israel suante'n TOUPA asaptak un, TOUPA'N Gera tapa Ehud, Benjamin mi, miveilong, hunkhepa abawlsak hi. Israel suante'n Moab kumpipa piak ding kipahman Ehud atawisak uhi.
Ehud in namsau hiamtuah tongtan a sau in asek a; puan nuai ah ataklam pheipi ah ahenbelh hi.
Moab kumpipa Eglon kipahman ava pia a; Eglon bel mithautak ahi.
Kipahman ava piak khit in, kipahman tawite apaisak nawn hi.

Amah bel Gilgal kho kiang a suangsekna mun a pan anungkik nawn a, "I aw, kumpipa, hon hilh ding thuguk ka nei hi," achi hi. Ama'n, "Dai un," achi hi. Huchi in akiang a dingh teng in apawtkhiaksan vek uhi.
Ehud in akiang ava naih a; amah bel anipi dantan ah amah kia in ana tu hi. Ehud in, "Pathian in na kiang a gen ding thu ahon thukhak hi," achi hi. Atutphah a kipan amah hong dingh hi.
Ehud in akhut veilam in apheipi taklam a namsau adokkhia a, agil ah adawt hi.
Anamsau bul tan in atum a, athau in namsau ahubit a, agilpi a pan namsau adokkhe kei a, a-ek atolhkhia hi.
Huchi in Ehud inlim ah apawt a, dantan kongkhakte akhakkhum a, akalh bikbek hi.
Apawt khit nung in, asikhate ahong pai ua, ava ettak un ngai in, dantan kongkhakte ana kikalh hi. "Anipi dantan ah atuam om tadih a hi in teh," achi uhi.
Zumhuai tan khop in angak nilouh ua, ngai in, dantan kongkhakte ahong himhim kei a; huchi in chabi ala ua, ahong ua; ngai in, akumpipa uh pialkhang ah sisa in ana puk hi.
Ehud lah huchi a angak nilouh sung un ana taimang khin a, huai suangsekna mun akheng a, Seirah ah atailut hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, huai mun atun in Ephraim tanggam ah pengkul amut a, Israel suante tanggam a pan akiang ah apaisuk ua, ama'n ama uh akaita hi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Hon zui dih ua. TOUPA'N na melma uh Moabte hon pe khinta ahi,” achi hi. Huchi in azuisuk ua, Moab gam chin Jordan lui kannate ala ua; kuamah agalkah uh aphal kei hi.
Huai hun in Moabte mihat ngen taleh mihat hangsan hoih ngenta singkhat athat ua; khat lel leng taikhia a-om kei uh.
Huchi in huai ni in Israelte lak ah Moabte azahlak uhi. Huchi in gam kum sawmgiat sung galmuang in a-om hi.
Anung in Anath tapa Shamgar ahong kilang a, huai mi'n bawng sutna chiang in Philistiate zaguk asunlum a; Israelte ahunkhia hi.
heading: Shamgar
